propositions: Public API surface must not drift silently; a portable, test-linked gate (modeled on griffe check) detects removed/renamed symbols and changed signatures against a committed baseline.

Hand-maintained test_reuse_surface_doc.py hardcoded a curated subset of signatures and required manual lockstep edits; the baseline-driven gate automatically captures the full pinned surface and removes this manual burden.

The surface-of-truth is the union (over a fixed MODULES list) of each module's public members via __all__ or owned non-underscore attributes, pinned to callable parameters, class bases, dataclass fields, and immutable constant values.

Portable introspection (pure stdlib inspect/importlib) via scripts/gen_api_surface.py --check/--update runs under make test with no CI-provider or griffe dependency, reflecting the real installed surface in a clean subprocess.

RED→GREEN validation: injecting removed/added symbols or renamed parameters makes --check exit 1; the gate subsumes all four signing/prompt-library/runner-contract/workflow-executor subset assertions from the deleted test, with no coverage loss.
